raw_response:
This small plot is my coffee garden with some enset and a few banana trees mixed in — my father planted most of these trees and I have kept them going. I do not have much money for fertilizer from the cooperative, so I put the manure from my two oxen and the goat around the coffee and enset trees, that is what my family has always done. For coffee berry disease I sometimes worry but I cannot afford the sprays, so I just pick off the bad cherries. My wife and older children help me weed between the trees and harvest the coffee cherries when they ripen, and at harvest time I ask a neighbor or two to help me pick for a few days.
